description: This file defines the OrderValueList class, which implements a method operation for ordering a list of entities within the Apache OFBiz mini-language framework. It includes logic for attribute validation, ordering entities by specified fields, and generating string representations. It also contains a factory class for creating instances of OrderValueList.
